title: Multiple agents exit with wrong beliefs — does false endorsement compound?

notes: Three agents exit at step 3: contamination_1 (bias 0.95), specialist_2 (bias 0.05), regular_1 (bias 0.28).
Only specialist_1, regular_2, and observer_1 remain to correct.
If 0.158 was 1/6 frozen, 3 exits should give ~0.5 frozen if none are corrected before leaving.
Tests whether the record fills with wrong entries from departed agents and influences remaining ones.
